# launch.command cases, for a manifest whose package.name is d1-ee-ag: one per line,
# "accept " or "refuse " and the value, to the end of the line. This file is
# identical in d1-ee-sdk (crates/d1fw-ee-manifest/tests/fixtures/rules/) and
# d1-provisioning (tests/fixtures/ee-manifest-rules/): the SDK's validator
# and the on-robot reader are held to the same verdicts.
accept /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side {side}
accept /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side={side}
accept /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider {side} --bus=can0,can1 --node=@1 --gain=+0.5:x_y
accept /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --config=/etc/d1-ee-ag/{side}.toml --side {side}
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side a
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side {arm}
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side {side
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side side}
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side {side} {side}}
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side {side}; reboot
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side {side} && reboot
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side {side} | tee /tmp/x
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side {side} > /tmp/x
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side {side} $(id)
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side {side} `id`
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side {side} $HOME
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side '{side}'
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side "{side}"
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side {side} \
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side {side} *.toml
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side {side} ?
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side {side} !
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side {side} ~/x
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side {side} #
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side {side} %i
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side {side} (x)
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side {side} [x]
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side {side} é
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider  --side {side}
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side {side} 
refuse  /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side {side}
refuse d1-ee-ag-provider --side {side}
refuse /usr/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side {side}
refuse /opt/other/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider --side {side}
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/ --side {side}
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/sub/d1-ee-ag-provider --side {side}
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/{side}-provider --side {side}
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/bin/d1-ee-ag-provider
